Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Senior Manager Data Science
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Manager of Data Science.

  • Are you an experienced leader in Data Science ready for your next-level adventure?
  • Does the thought of working with one of the most comprehensive employment data sets in the world excite you?
  • Are you inspired by transformation and making an impact on the lives of millions of people every day?

IMPORTANT: Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location, It is necessary to live nearby.

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you'll have access to the most unique and one of the largest HCM data sets and do exploratory analysis to understand if it meets project requirements. It's more than digits and dials - you're making huge decisions that impact millions of customers.

Every day you'll work with multiple stakeholders to identify, design, develop and implement advanced AI and machine learning projects that influence daily life of working people. You'll work with your team to provide, interpret, and predict necessary metrics for decision-making. You'll code with machine learning tools like Python, R, and Scala to synthesize millions of data sets into patterns that answer ad hoc requests and then use Tableau for data visualization. You will create models that guide professional through daily working decisions related to every aspect of working life.

To thrive in this career, you should know how to identify errors and reactively fix them. You'll need to have some formal education in quantitative analytics and know design patterns and data structures. You have the skills to create new models using the technologies above. You will coach and mentor junior data scientists with different strengths to solve various problems with different methodologies and analyses. But given the scale of our data sets and the complex problems we give you to solve, you will stay challenged and engaged with years of exciting projects ahead—all while growing your skills and progressing in a rewarding career.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Setup, Build and Grow the Team. You will work in close collaboration with the USA Data Science and Machine Learning team to setup the goals and roadmap to assemble a world-class team in close alignment with the company’s OKRs.
  • Own and Manage Projects. You will identify, design, develop, and implement advanced analytical projects.
  • You will design, implement and deploy high-performing machine learning/AI models and create API endpoints in AWS.
  • Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modeling. You bring prior experience to the role of formulating problems, extracting & analyzing data from multiple systems, summarizing critical findings/insights, and developing a compelling visual representation of analyses with actionable recommendations—this will set you up for success on Day 1. You will interact with developer, UX designer, product manager, and senior executives to understand problem domain, project requirements, users experience and demonstrate model performance and its business value
  • Limitless Possibilities. You will continue learning and discovering new ways to leverage ADP data to create new products and services and find more insights. You are passionate about learning and applying new techniques within data science that leads to innovations.
  • Collaboration and Communication. You'll be part of a collaborative team, listening to needs, then finding and sharing solutions. You're comfortable and skilled at presenting to both peers and leadership on your projects and findings.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • PhD in quantitative area and 8+ years’ experience in Data Science or related field is required, with at least 4 years’ experience as a Team Leader.
  • Prior experience in Python, SQL, LMM, IA and distributed computing tools such as Databricks, AWS or other Cloud platforms; Well versed with Scikit-learn, PyTorch or other machine learning libraries and platforms.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

In SOTEC Consulting - Astek Group, we are seeking an Angular Front-End Developer with strong experience building real-time, data-driven web applications.   • Experience using version control systems ( Git ).

  • Strong communication skills in Spanish .

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD/BDD);
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura, escalabilidade e segurança dos nossos produtos;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta performance;
  • Garantir desenvolvimento seguro, observando atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no time, apoiando colegas menos experientes e disseminando boas práticas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas distribuídas e de alto volume de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de engenharia de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, TDD, documentação, code review, etc);
  • Experiência em Go ou Node.js, com abertura para aprender outras stacks;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Experiência com infraestrutura em Cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Conhecimentos em APIs Rest, Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento em processos de versionamento e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com observabilidade (monitoramento, logging, tracing, métricas);
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração em equipe;
  • Capacidade de encarar mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento e atuar como mentor(a);
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com perspectiva de governança de dados;
  • Experiência com front-end moderno (Vue.js, Angular, React);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (PubSub, SNS, Kafka);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise e busca (BigQuery, ElasticSearch).

title: Front End Engineer (Sanity)
description:
Join Our Client as a Front End Engineer (Sanity)

About the Organisation


Our Client operates within the digital technology space, delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of online experiences. Renowned for their collaborative culture and commitment to growth, they foster a dynamic environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive. Recognised for leading-edge projects and a supportive community, it's an excellent place to develop your career and make a meaningful impact.
Role Overview
Due to an exciting expansion driven by strategic initiatives, our Client is seeking a talented Front End Engineer with expertise in SanityCMS. This role is key to enhancing their digital presence and delivering seamless user experiences. It offers a unique chance to embed yourself in innovative projects that influence global digital platforms. If you are passionate about modern front-end development and eager to push boundaries, this opportunity is perfect for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces using React and TypeScript, aligning with best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate design concepts into functional web components.
  • Integrate and optimise SanityCMS to ensure content management is efficient and user-friendly.
  • Write clean, maintainable code in HTML, CSS, and TS, ensuring optimal performance across browsers and devices.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and refining performance to uphold high-quality standards.
  • Contribute to continual improvement of development processes and technical documentation.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience building front-end applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5/CSS3 for crafting responsive and accessible layouts.
  • Hands-on experience with SanityCMS or similar headless CMS solutions.
  • Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a team and follow clear technical guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and quality.


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Additional experience with other JavaScript frameworks or libraries.
  • Knowledge of build tools and package managers like Webpack, npm, or Yarn.
  • Understanding of SEO best practices and performance optimisation techniques.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX principles and graphic design tools.


Ready to Make an Impact?


If you are excited by the prospect of developing cutting-edge digital experiences and meet the essential criteria, we encourage you to submit your CV today. Join our Client's journey to innovate and shape the future of online content delivery.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an Integration Engineer who is responsible for driving and integrating customers with our platform and products.

Externally, you’ll be interfacing with enterprise eCommerce merchants who are looking to reduce online fraud rates, increase their bottom line, and want to start using our platform as soon as possible.

You will be the technical expert and point of contact throughout the E2E integration process.

The goal of an Integrations Engineer is to make a complex process as easy and effortless as possible for each new client. You’ll wear many hats: relaying client feedback and providing technical influence on product roadmap/development, technical ownership of various plugins/extensions, and collaborating with developers to drive commercial issues to resolution.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Have a deep understanding of our system and our product capabilities
  • Provide end-to-end support for new clients during their onboarding process from a technical and operational integration perspective
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management efforts (presales and post-sales) as one of our strongest subject matter experts
  • Build, monitor, and execute a joint integration project plan across multiple clients and integrations
  • Own and improve public-facing SDKs, APIs, and technical integration guides

Qualifications

  • 6+ years experience as an Integrations Engineer / Solution Engineer / Advanced Technical Manager - collaborating with multiple technical teams of an organization such as DevOps or Product, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • An incredibly strong “can do”, and continuous learning attitude.
  • Experience working with databases and querying languages (e.g. SQL)
  • Excel in critical thinking and technical troubleshooting of multi-layered, complex problem statements while maintaining excellent internal and external stakeholder relationships
  • Proven technical background with API integrations; should be comfortable reading logs and source code
  • Substantial experience in a client-facing technical role, including face-to-face meetings and pre-sales activities with enterprise merchants
  • Experience in planning, leading, and executing technical projects with Enterprise clients
  • Collaborative and inclusive team player with superb written and verbal communication skills

description:
A Química Anastacio é uma das maiores distribuidoras de produtos químicos da América Latina e oferece um amplo portfólio de produtos e ingredientes, além de soluções e serviços inteligentes, auxiliando os clientes e fornecedores no crescimento dos seus negócios. Contamos com uma excelente estrutura comercial, logística e técnica, e atendemos todas as indústrias do mercado.

Nos últimos anos, fortalecemos nossas operações transformando em ágil, simples e focada no cliente. Hoje temos 6 centros de distribuições localizados estrategicamente no Brasil, presença na Argentina e México, com meta de expandir nossa participação no mercado da América Latina e representamos cerca de 400 fornecedores globais.

Para mais informações, visite

Na Química Anastácio, acreditamos que equipes diversas constroem soluções mais inovadoras e sustentáveis.

Nosso compromisso com a diversidade vai além do discurso: promovemos um ambiente onde todas as pessoas são respeitadas, valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer.

Temos orgulho dos nossos squads de diversidade — Gênero, Étnico-Racial, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, PCDs e Parentalidade — que atuam ativamente para tornar nossa cultura mais inclusiva e representativa.

Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, acolhedor e diverso , e buscamos constantemente ampliar a representatividade em nossos times. Incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes histórias, trajetórias e experiências. #VEMSERANASTACIO

Principais atividades:

  • Fortalecer o relacionamento com clientes existentes, garantindo atendimento de excelência e identificação de novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Realizar abertura e prospecção de novos clientes, contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável da carteira.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas de vendas, com foco em crescimento, rentabilidade e margem.
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre a área comercial e as equipes de backoffice, garantindo fluidez na comunicação e nos processos.
  • Participar de negociações estratégicas, apoiando a definição de condições comerciais e direcionamentos táticos.
  • Monitorar indicadores (KPIs), realizar follow-up contínuo e propor planos de ação.
  • Gerenciar equipes multidisciplinares, assegurando alinhamento, engajamento e performance.

Requisitos:

  • Formação em Marketing, Administração, Química, Engenharia Química, Cosmetologia ou Farmácia.
  • Experiência na distribuição química.
  • Experiência com liderança de equipes.
  • Habilidade em gestão de indicadores comerciais.
  • Inglês avançado e conhecimento em CRM – desejável/diferencial.

Local de trabalho : Pinheiros, São Paulo - SP

Modelo híbrido : 3 dias presenciais na semana

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira das 8h00 às 17h45

title: Analista de Integridade e Investigações Sênior
description:
Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

title: F&I Specialist
description:
About Us:

Chery is a leading Chinese automotive company with a diverse portfolio that includes the R&D, production, and sales of passenger cars, commercial vehicles, mini cars, specialty vehicles, and powertrain systems. With over 8.75 million vehicles sold globally, Chery serves customers in more than 80 countries and regions worldwide.

Omoda & Jaecoo is an innovative new brand under the Chery Group, operating independently from other Chery brands. It focuses on cutting-edge design and technology in the production and sales of passenger vehicles.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the full Finance & Insurance (F&I) process, ensuring a positive and seamless customer experience at the dealership level.
  • Present and explain financing options, insurance products, warranties, and value-added services in a clear and compliant manner.
  • Build strong partnerships with financial institutions, banks, and insurance providers to negotiate competitive rates, commissions, and product offerings.
  • Ensure full compliance with regulatory, financial, and ethical standards across all F&I operations.
  • Support dealer teams with training on F&I processes, systems, customer approach, and product knowledge.
  • Review and validate all documentation related to vehicle financing, insurance, and contract execution.
  • Monitor KPIs such as penetration rates, product mix, revenue per vehicle, and conversion ratios.
  • Develop strategies to increase F&I performance, customer satisfaction, and retention.
  • Collaborate closely with sales teams to align on customer needs and support the end-to-end sales process.
  • Maintain updated knowledge of market trends, financial regulations, and competitor offerings.

Requirements:

  • Solid experience in F&I operations within the automotive sector (dealerships or OEMs).
  • Strong understanding of financing structures, insurance products, warranties, and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent negotiation and relationship-management skills with financial partners.
  • Customer-centric approach, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly.
  • High attention to detail for contract validation and documentation controls.
  • Analytical mindset to track KPIs, identify opportunities, and support business planning.
  • Ability to train and guide dealership teams on best practices for F&I processes.
  • Familiarity with F&I systems, CRM platforms, and digital sales tools is a plus.

Location and work-mode:

  • 100% on-site in Morumbi region (Rochaverá building in front of Shopping Morumbi).
